title: Fix type-check failures in plugin-gantt and plugin-calendar
body:
`pnpm type-check` fails on `plugin-gantt` and `plugin-calendar` because their stories import `@storybook-config/datasource`, a Vite alias defined only in `.storybook/main.ts` — invisible to `tsc`.

These two packages override `baseUrl`/`paths` in their `tsconfig.json`, which means `tsc --noEmit` attempts to resolve the alias and fails. Other packages either don't have a `type-check` script or don't override paths.

- **Fix**: Exclude `**/*.stories.tsx` from type-checking in both packages, consistent with how `**/*.test.ts{x}` is already excluded

```jsonc
// packages/plugin-gantt/tsconfig.json & packages/plugin-calendar/tsconfig.json
"exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts", "**/*.test.tsx", "**/*.stories.tsx"]
```

Type-check result: 53/57 → 57/57 tasks passing.
